subject: Private deployment: consolidated pricing, platform fee, and support tier proposal
messages:
From: Jiang Li <jiang.li@cloudworks.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment pricing details request

Hi Connor / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo this morning. We liked Redwood's serving runtime and the routing/fallback features for multi-region availability. Before we take this to procurement, could you send a consolidated cost table for a private deployment (VPC) and an on-prem option? Specifically: platform fee structure, per-node licensing, support tiers (SLA, response times, included hours), and any standard discounts for a 3-year committed ARR.

We are evaluating two deployment patterns:
- VPC across two regions (primary+DR) with dedicated pools (approx. 8 GPUs steady, peak to 14)
- On-prem appliance for testing and sensitive workloads (initial pilot: 2 x A100 equivalent)

Target timeline: procurement review by Dec 4. Thanks — if you can get something before Monday that would be great.

Regards,
Jiang
Jiang Li
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudWorks
jiang.li@cloudworks.io

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Jiang Li <jiang.li@cloudworks.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing details request

Hi Jiang —

Thanks, glad the demo was useful. Attached is an initial proposal (RW_Private_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf) and an editable MA-plan workbook with line-item assumptions. Highlights here so procurement can scan:

- Platform fee: flat annual platform fee + usage component. Standard: $90k/year platform fee for VPC (includes control plane, monitoring, basic observability retention).
- Per-node licensing: $6,000/month per GPU-equivalent reserved (billing granularity monthly).
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 24-hr bug response), Priority (24/7, 4-hr P1), Enterprise (named SE, quarterly architecture reviews, 1:1 SLOs).
- On-prem: one-time on-prem packaging fee ($40k) + per-node license same as VPC. KMS integrations and audit-log exports included for Enterprise tier.

I'll call out discount bands in the workbook but as a rule we offer 10-15% off platform fee for 12–24 month commitments and 18–25% for 36 months with an ARR threshold.

If you'd like, I can draft a mutual action plan and loop in Marcus for any special concession approvals.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0124

From: Jiang Li <jiang.li@cloudworks.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudworks.io>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing details request

Connor —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and workbook. A couple of clarifying points from procurement:

1) If we commit to 3 years and meet the ARR threshold, can Redwood push platform fee discount to 25%? Procurement prefers a stronger up-front concession given the size of the spend and that some workloads will remain on-prem.
2) For on-prem, we need clarity on maintenance windows, remote patching options, and whether the on-prem packaging fee can be amortized into the first-year invoice.
3) Are SOC2 + audit logs included in Enterprise support by default? Procurement will want that documented in the SOW.

Goal: a signed agreement & SOW before Dec 15. Could you provide a revised line item set explaining how the platform fee discount scales with commit and whether there are migration credits for lift-and-shift work?

Appreciate it,
Jiang

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment pricing details request — approval ask for concession

Marcus — quick note, forwarding CloudWorks procurement thread. They are evaluating VPC + on-prem pilot and are requesting a 25% platform-fee discount on a 36-month commit and asking to amortize the one-time on-prem packaging fee into year one. Summary of their profile:
- Estimated committed ARR: ~$1.1M over 3 years (platform + reserved node licenses)
- Pilot (on-prem) likely to convert to 2 region VPC over 12 months

We typically cap platform fee discounts at 20% for ARR <= $1.5M unless we include additional commitments (longer marketing/reference, joint case study, or incremental renewal protection). I think we can consider 22% if we attach a renewal protection clause and 25% if Marcus approves an executive concession.

Would you be comfortable approving a one-time exec concession to 25% on platform fee in exchange for:
- 36-month contract with an annual true-up clause
- Public reference (case study) after 6 months
- Acceptance of our standard migration credit schedule (30% of first-year node license spend applied to services)

Also: can we amortize the $40k on-prem packaging fee into the first-year invoice if finance okays? That will help procurement.

Thanks,
Connor

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing details request — approval ask for concession

Connor / Lauren —

Good summary. Approve the 25% platform fee concession for CloudWorks under the following binding conditions:

1) 36-month term signed within 30 days of this approval, with annual true-up and minimum ARR of $1.05M.
2) Public case study + reference call scheduled in Q2 2027 (marketing draft to be shared with customer).
3) Migration credits: 30% of first-year node license spend applied as services credit; credits expire after 12 months.
4) Amortize on-prem packaging fee over the first 12 months (Finance to confirm invoice plan; Connor coordinate with finance ops).

Marcus approves the concession on the condition Finance signs off on amortization and Legal includes the SOW language about SOC2 and audit log delivery under Enterprise tier. Please prepare final pricing SOW and DocuSign bundle.

-Marcus
VP, Strategic Sales
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Jiang Li <jiang.li@cloudworks.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@cloudworks.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Updated offer: CloudWorks private deployment (Platform fee concession approved)

Hi Jiang / procurement team —

Thanks for the patience. Per internal approval, Redwood can offer the following for CloudWorks contingent on the 36-month commitment and minimum ARR provisions below:

- Platform fee: $90k/year base, reduced by 25% (effective $67.5k/year) for a 36-month signed term.
- Per-node licensing: $6,000/month per GPU-equivalent (same as workbook).
- On-prem packaging fee: $40k, amortized across the first 12 months (Finance to invoice as 12 x $3,333 if accepted).
- Migration credits: 30% of first-year node-license spend applied as services credit (applies to professional services / migration support).
- Support: Enterprise tier included for first 12 months (SOC2 evidence + audit-log exports included).

Deliverables we will include in the SOW and DocuSign package: detailed SLOs, SOC2 appendix, KMS integration checklist, migration credit schedule, and public-case-study consent language. Link to DocuSign bundle: https://www.docusign.net/Tx12345-CloudWorks

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement reviews SOW (attached in this thread).
2) If accepted, we finalize DocuSign and aim to sign by Dec 15 to meet your timeline.

If procurement needs any variance (e.g., change to amortization schedule or different SE coverage), call me and I will try to accommodate with Marcus and Finance.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0124

---
Attachments: RW_Private_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf (pricing workbook), CloudWorks_MA-plan.xlsx (mutual action plan)
From: Jiang Li <jiang.li@cloudworks.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@cloudworks.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2026 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated offer: CloudWorks private deployment (Platform fee concession approved)

Connor —

Appreciate the clarity and quick internal run. Procurement is pleased with the 25% platform-fee concession and the amortization option. We will review the DocuSign bundle and SOW today and aim to get a redline back by Wednesday.

Quick clarifying Qs for the SOW team:
- Can you explicitly list the SOC2 deliverables and expected turnaround for evidence requests?
- Will remote patching be opt-in for on-prem or is it required for security updates (we prefer opt-in with an agreed maintenance window).

I will loop in security for a short call tomorrow if needed. Thanks again —

Jiang
